newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel bearish, veering to 128.16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel bearish, veering to 128.16.

text.p: September notionnel bond futures on Matif are showing a downward trend, technical analysts said on Friday.

"The contract is bearish for today because the Bollinger bands are in divergence on an hourly basis," said Philippe Cahen, technical analyst at Credit Lyonnais in Paris. "The higher band is going higher, and the lower band is going lower."
Bollinger bands are lines drawn at standard derviations around the price action to give support and resistance.
September French bond futures were trading at 128.52 at 0753 GMT, 14 basis points below Thursday's settlement price.
"We are most likely to come back to the lower Bollinger band support on a daily basis, at 128.16," said Cahen.
Below there, Cahen saw further support at 127.82, a level based on MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) analysis.
"Stochastics and MACD are oversold," he said.
Elli Gifford, independent technical analyst near Cambridge, was more bullish on the market.
"The picture is more positive, with 128.50 support for now." The contract slipped below 128.50 earlier in the session, but came back from a low of 128.48.
"But we are likely to be rangebound," she added.
Cahen found resistance for the contract at 128.84, the moving average for Bollinger bands on a 30 minute basis.
Gifford said there were no clear levels of resistance between current levels and 129.50, but she added the market would be unlikely to get that far on Friday.
September Pibor futures were at 96.51, down one basis point.
"A deeper slump to the 96.45 trendline looks on the cards," said Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in a research note.
